title: Draft transition, as DEL-01-04 receives it (PROPOSED receiving requirement, DEL-01-04/NIR-v0.1 §7)
description: PROPOSED by DEL-01-04/NIR-v0.1 (R17-1; OUT-004, REQ-004). DEL-02-02 owns the transition and its format: WR-v0.1 §5.1 and `workspace-registration.schema.json` $defs/draft_transition (node D5). This schema restates that shape with D5's own element names and values (record_kind, event, draft {draft_location, draft_root, name}, content, from, to, disposition, cause, time, attribution), so the two can be compared line by line, and adds the two elements DEL-01-04 needs that D5's shape does not carry: for the events 'registered' and 'registration not completed', the A15 human-act record ('a15_record', which the App act control wrote at capture, K-8) and, for 'registered', the revision ('revision'). Those two are a request to DEL-02-02 (join J-W1); until it carries them, DEL-01-04 reads them from D5's library_entry. Per R17-11 an A15's relations are the reviewed draft and the prior revision; WD's derived-from (the parent workflow identity) is not carried here.

a15_record.description: Requested addition (J-W1): the RS human_act A15 record the App act control wrote.

revision.description: Requested addition (J-W1): the registered revision identity.

allOf.description: Content is carried where the draft's content is what changed or was reviewed.
DEL-01-04 shows a draft as registered only with the A15 record and the revision (REQ-004: no invented registration).
A registration that did not complete still cites the recorded act.
A refusal carries its disposition (K-6: 'refused: name taken' asks for a new name).
